martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Hab Base Camp: Octavia E. Butler Landing Floor (+6.5m Mast)
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Flat fractured Maaz crater floor (Ncu) at Hab base camp; low roughness confirms safe EVA staging.

martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Science WP-1: Three Forks Sample Depot & Delta Base
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Stratified delta front outcrops (NHdf) at Three Forks; moderate benching above crater floor.

martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Science WP-2: Hawksbill Gap Sedimentary Fan Traverse
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Eolian sand ripples (Aeb) flanking Hawksbill Gap; low thermal inertia increases boot sinkage.

martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Science WP-3: Kodiak Butte Delta Remnant & Boulder Talus
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Steep boulder talus apron (Asu) below Kodiak Butte; high Sobel edge density triggers roughness boost.

martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Extended EVA Target: Neretva Vallis Bright Angel Bench (Chunk 1,2)
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Eastern delta plain terrace (NHdp) in Chunk (1,2); requires dynamic 3x3 chunk migration.

martian_streetview_rover_images.title: Extended EVA Target: Carbonate Margin Overlook (Chunk 0,1)
martian_streetview_rover_images.caption: Northern carbonate margin outcrop (NHl) in Chunk (0,1); tests north-south chunk seam stitching.
